preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain owner privileges)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the blacklistAddress() function with any contract address and set value to true. This will prevent that contract from making any transactions (transfers, swaps, etc.) by causing the _transfer() function to revert with 'Blacklisted address' error. The exploit demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can arbitrarily stop any contract from interacting with the token.
